# 🪪 AGR-069 · `trial-eligibility-screener`

> Screen patients against trial criteria cheapest-first, escalating ambiguous cases to a clinician.

| Card ID | Domain | Pattern | Nodes | Edges | Verifiers | Routers | Max steps | Risk surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGR-069` | healthcare-science | **pipeline** | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 30 | execute |

> 🎯 **Requires a goal** — the trial to screen against and the cohort to screen. Without one the graph refuses and runs no node.

## The graph

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    N0["prefilter<br/><i>screener</i>"]
    N1["criteria-match<br/><i>analyst</i>"]
    N2["deep-review<br/><i>escalator</i>"]
    N3["clinician-review<br/><i>approver</i>"]
    N4["enrol<br/><i>executor</i>"]
    N0 --> N1
    N1 -->|len(ambiguous) == 0| N4
    N1 -->|len(ambiguous) > 0| N2
    N2 --> N3
    N3 --> N4
```

Legend: `[/…/]` router · `{{…}}` verifier · `[…]` worker/agent node.

## What it does

Screen criteria against records for informational matching.

## Why it should deliver results

Staged specialists each own one narrow concern, so quality problems are localized to the stage that produced them instead of being smeared across a single mega-prompt. Output only leaves the graph through the exit contract.

- **Exit contract** — an ambiguous eligibility decision never enrols without a clinician signature
- **Machine-checked** — `output.unreviewed_ambiguous == 0`
- **Bounded** — hard stop after 30 steps; the topology is acyclic
- **Golden cases** — `uv run agr eval trial-eligibility-screener` replays recorded cases through the real edge/assert logic (mock runner proves mechanics; `--live` measures your model)
- **Trace gallery** — [every case's route, node outputs, and checked asserts](../../../docs/traces/trial-eligibility-screener.md)

## How to work with it

```bash
uv run agr show trial-eligibility-screener       # full definition
uv run agr profile trial-eligibility-screener    # deterministic structural facts
uv run agr mermaid trial-eligibility-screener    # regenerate the diagram below
uv run agr eval trial-eligibility-screener       # run golden cases (add --live for your endpoint)
uv run agr adapt trial-eligibility-screener --target langgraph > app.py   # compile to runnable LangGraph
uv run agr optimize trial-eligibility-screener   # propose bounded structural improvements (dry-run)
```

Over MCP: `uv run agr mcp` exposes the registry (search / show / profile) to any MCP client.
To evolve it: `uv run agr infuse trial-eligibility-screener <node> <ability>` — every mutation is gate-checked and appended to the graph's lineage log.

## Node roster

| Node | Speciality | Kind | Abilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prefilter` | screener | agent | screen |
| `criteria-match` | analyst | agent | analyze |
| `deep-review` | escalator | agent | escalate, classify_complexity |
| `clinician-review` | approver | human | approve |
| `enrol` | executor | agent | execute_step |

## Edge logic

| From | To | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `prefilter` | `criteria-match` | always |
| `criteria-match` | `enrol` | len(ambiguous) == 0 |
| `criteria-match` | `deep-review` | len(ambiguous) > 0 |
| `deep-review` | `clinician-review` | always |
| `clinician-review` | `enrol` | always |
